ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms observed resources, the observation window and the single-peak flag are declared; it does not read utilization data.
offer: Measure utilization over a representative window and inspect multiple constrained resources. A single peak does not establish steady-state capacity or an opportunity to reduce it.

minimal.reason: List the resources observed, such as CPU and memory. Watching one resource misses the constrained one, so name each.

mid.reason: Observe for at least 7 days. A shorter window misses weekly cycles, so cover a representative period.

maximal.reason: Set deciding from a single peak to false. One spike does not establish steady-state capacity, so use the distribution.
